title: Travel?
content: Last night for the first time ever I was able to travel out of my wall world and into someone else’s. My cousin who IRL lives thousands of miles away. When I was visiting, everything was different, her downtown, her freeways, I was able to see at least 3 “Malls” from the outside, but we never went in. I should tell you that in my mallworld I’ve never actually seen a mall. Stores, yes, strip malls, all the time, but actual indoor shopping malls with large anchor stores don’t exist in my MW. Even her roller coasters and sea shore was different, but yet the same. I’m so tempted to call her and ask if she experienced this too, I just don’t want to sound insane! Has anyone else experienced other people’s MW? I legit talked to her about moving there. She even had agreed to rent me her finished basement for $50 a month. It was really like an actual visit, we went everywhere! She was showing me around. Like I was in a new town. So odd.
